_doc: Neutral en-us writer placeholders for expEvent_politician_small.json. Keys match zh-cn; legacy keys retained.

en-us.exp_event_erav_politician_small_sake_ong: As the accompanying secretary, $names$ waits on the ryokan's socializing.
en-us.exp_event_erav_politician_small_sake_res: $names$ kneels and pours sake for the full table. The angle of the bottle is corrected three times before the councillor nods.
$names$ is called to sit at the councillor's knees, his hand touring slowly over her legs through the yukata, the way one inventories luggage.
In a lull of the party, $names$ is told to fan the councillor. As she fans, someone idly pulls half her yukata collar open.
en-us.exp_event_erav_politician_small_bath_ong: $names$ is summoned to attend the councillor in the bath.
en-us.exp_event_erav_politician_small_bath_res: In the bathhouse $names$ kneels at the pool's edge scrubbing the councillor's back. At his waist her head is pressed round - "the front first".
$names$ soaks in the pool with the councillor, seated on his lap while he washes her. It is called washing; the hands are doing an inventory.
en-us.exp_event_erav_politician_small_yukata_o: In the ryokan corridor a maid stops $names$.
en-us.exp_event_erav_politician_small_yukata_r: The maid re-ties $names$'s yukata sash in the style taught in the councillor's room: nothing else permitted beneath the skirt. It is 'house rules'.
The maid leads $names$ room to room serving tea. Every guest's eyes linger on her; nobody finds it strange - the tag on her chest reads 'the councillor's attendant'.
en-us.exp_event_erav_politician_small_quickie_: The councillor's voice calls $names$ into his room.
During the midday lull the councillor has $names$ kneel at his low table and serve him briefly, then sends her back on duty.
